subject: Securitex pilot: clarify deployment preference, rate expectations, and next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jm@securitex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Securitex pilot: post-demo recap & quick clarifications

Hi Jordan (and Priya),

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great questions from the Securitex team. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can scope the right pilot: 

Summary from our side:
- You liked the low-latency responses on the hosted demo and the model fallback behavior.
- Primary concern: throughput during batch processing windows and data residency / PCI boundaries.
- Goal: fast proof-of-concept within 2–3 weeks, then decide on Hosted vs Dedicated for production.

Clarifying questions to help recommend the right deployment:
1) Short-term preference: do you want to evaluate Hosted API exclusively for the quickstart, or do you want a Dedicated-reserved trial right away? (Hosted is quickest; Dedicated gives predictable capacity but requires a contract.)
2) Expected traffic profile for the pilot: average requests/sec and expected peak burst (if you have RPS or QPS numbers, please share).
3) Typical prompt + response token ranges (we saw token length can change cost & throughput).
4) Any hard latency SLOs for interactive vs batch flows?
5) Compliance constraints we should know about up front (PCI scope, required region, or VPC-only access).

Attached is a one-pager that outlines the Hosted quickstart and the sandbox endpoints we can provision. If Hosted looks sufficient for the pilot, we can hand off to Ben to set up sandbox endpoints and a traffic slice.

Proposed next steps:
- You reply with the QPS/token numbers and preference on Hosted vs Dedicated.
- If Hosted: Ben will provision a sandbox and we’ll schedule a 30m ops preflight.
- If Dedicated: we’ll run a capacity footprint call and loop in Sales Ops for commitment details.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: hosted-quickstart-one-pager.pdf (1 page)

From: Jordan Meyers <jm@securitex.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Anand <priya.anand@securitex.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Securitex pilot: post-demo recap & quick clarifications

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear recap. Answers inline below: 

1) Short term: we prefer Hosted API for the quickstart so we can validate the integration before committing to Dedicated. Dedicated is likely later if latency/cost needs push that direction.

2) Traffic profile: baseline ~20 req/s for the interactive UI, but we expect scheduled batch runs that could spike to ~200 req/s for short windows (10–15 minutes). The batches are fairly bursty once per day.

3) Token ranges: average prompt ~120 tokens; average generated response ~350 tokens. Some edge cases hit 1k tokens but rare.

4) Latency SLOs: interactive UI needs ~<300ms p50 (we can tolerate higher p95 in early trials). Batch jobs are throughput-first.

5) Compliance: we are PCI-in-scope for payment metadata and prefer US region deployment. For the quickstart, we can anonymize card data; long-term we may need Private VPC (or Dedicated with a strict data-handling addendum).

Also — can you tell us the Hosted rate limits (per-second / per-minute), and whether we can request a burst increase for the pilot?

Happy to take the sandbox endpoints if you can provision them; earliest we can start is next Monday (4/16).

—Jordan
Jordan Meyers
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
Securitex Inc.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <jm@securitex.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Apr 2028 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Securitex pilot: post-demo recap & quick clarifications

Hi Jordan — copying Ben (solutions) here to give concrete numbers and a recommended sandbox config. Quick answers and a recommended Hosted setup that fits your spike profile: 

Hosted rate limits (default sandbox slice):
- Per-API-key throttle: 50 requests/sec sustained, 250 requests/min burst token-bucket.
- Per-account concurrency: default 80 inflight tokens / model instance (this is fluid based on endpoint).
- We bill per input + output token; prefix/KV cache reduces repeated-token cost in conversational flows.

Given your profile (20 req/s baseline, 200 req/s spike for 10–15 minutes) we recommend:
- Provision a Hosted sandbox slice with burst uplift enabled: sustain 60 req/s with burst to 250 req/s for 20 minutes/day.
- Enable prefix KV caching for UI flows to reduce token usage on repeated prompts (saves cost and latency).
- Sandbox endpoints: we’ll create two endpoints in us-east-1: 
  - https://sandbox.redwoodinference.com/strict/securitex-v1 (interactive)
  - https://sandbox.redwoodinference.com/batch/securitex-batch (batch with higher concurrency)

If you need stricter PCI boundaries during pilot we can:
- Require tokenization pre-ingest (you own the tokenization) or
- Run Hosted with an NDA + specific retention controls (short retention) — but for full PCI-in-scope production we usually recommend Dedicated or Private VPC.

Attachments: sandbox-endpoint-instructions.txt (small text with curl examples + region hints).

Next steps I can own if Hosted:
- Lauren: confirm pilot start date (Jordan suggested 2028-04-16).
- I’ll provision the sandbox slice and share credentials + quick curl examples.
- Monica: can you join the ops preflight to cover ingestion/monitoring?

Let me know if you want me to size a Dedicated footprint instead; I can run a quick capacity estimate from your batch concurrency numbers.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: sandbox-endpoint-instructions.txt (curl examples)

Thanks Jordan — and thanks Ben for the clear sizing. Quick summary / agreed actions so we all have the same view: 

Agreed pilot plan:
- Mode: Hosted API quickstart (sandbox) with a burst uplift to support daily 200 req/s windows.
- Endpoints: Ben to provision the two sandbox endpoints in us-east-1 and share credentials by 2028-04-15 EOD.
- Start date: 2028-04-16 (Securitex to confirm Monday morning access).
- Compliance note: Securitex will anonymize PCI data for the pilot; we’ll re-evaluate Dedicated/Private for production.

Owners / next steps:
- Ben: provision sandbox slice + share sandbox-endpoint-instructions.txt (ETA today).
- Monica: ops preflight call — proposed Wed 4/17 10:00am ET to walk through monitoring and retention controls. Please confirm availability.
- Jordan / Priya: share any additional throughput test scripts or expected batch CSV schema so Ben can pre-warm the batch endpoint.

If anything changes on the scope (e.g., you want Dedicated sizing), Ben will run an estimate and we’ll loop Sales Ops. Otherwise — excited to kick off next week.

Best,
Lauren
